question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appropreately"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Appropriately"**.
 
• **Appropriately:** It means in a manner suitable or proper in the circumstances. (उचित रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **He was dressed **appropriately **for the formal dinner.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Analytically** (विश्लेषणात्मक रूप से): In a way that involves detailed examination or analysis.

 
 
• **Example:** She approached the problem **analytically **to find the best solution.
 
 
 
• **Apparently** (जाहिर तौर पर): As far as one knows or can see; seemingly.
 
 
• **Example:** **Apparently**, he is not coming to the party tonight.
 
 
 
• **Astonishingly** (आश्चर्यजनक रूप से): In an astonishing or surprising manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician performed **astonishingly **well and left the audience amazed.
